players.product: AI data-center colocation (Tydal, Norway: 121 IT MW leased to Volta for NVIDIA GPUs) and Bitdeer AI GPU cloud (NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 / Vera Rubin capacity in Malaysia, Norway and the US)

quarterly_data.quarter: Bitdeer Technologies press release: Bitdeer AI Expands Malaysia Campus with New 60MW A103 (10-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Bitdeer AI entered into an 8-year data center services agreement for A103, a 60MW AI Cloud data center facility on its Cyberjaya, Malaysia campus (with A101 and A102), designed for liquid-cooled, rack-scale NVIDIA systems including the next-generation NVIDIA Vera Rubin platform, with energization expected in Q1 2028; the Cyberjaya campus will represent approximately 71.5MW of AI Cloud data center capacity. Secured AI Cloud data center capacity now totals approximately 333.5MW across Malaysia, Norway and the United States, approximately 95% of its target of up to 350MW to be delivered by Q1 2028 (critical IT load). CFO Michael G. Potter: A103 'is also built for the Vera Rubin generation, which is the capacity customers are asking us about for 2028.'
quarterly_data.figure: A103 60MW (energization Q1 2028); Cyberjaya ~71.5MW; secured ~333.5MW, ~95% of up-to-350MW target by Q1 2028
